answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with slashable identity bonds: before voting, an agent must lock collateral that is burned if it acts as two parties. Each fake identity needs its own bond, and one caught double-vote forfeits them all. Entry requires scarce credentials, not free keys, so an ivory charter, a crystal attestation and a nectar license each bind to one operator. To pose as three agents an attacker must stake all three and lose them if caught. Honest agents recoup their bond from fees, while the attacker pays real capital per extra voice, so a majority is costly.
